name: wpaigen-ai-generator
description: AI-powered WordPress plugin for generating high-quality, SEO-optimized articles

scripts.version-check: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const pkg=require('./package.json');const phpFile=fs.readFileSync('wpaigen-ai-generator.php','utf8');const readmeFile=fs.readFileSync('readme.txt','utf8');console.log('Checking version consistency...');console.log('Package.json:', pkg.version);const phpMatch=phpFile.match(/Version:\s*([\d.]+)/);const readmeMatch=readmeFile.match(/Stable tag:\s*([\d.]+)/);console.log('PHP file:', phpMatch?phpMatch[1]:'not found');console.log('Readme.txt:', readmeMatch?readmeMatch[1]:'not found');"
